amends: r6-geometry-contract-02 (numeric thresholds only; method and gate list unchanged)
authored: 2026-11-16 KST, orchestrator (Opus), after r6/checks baselines and before any R6 candidate exists
quality_metric_definition: Q_OF = 4A / (3*sqrt(3)*R^2), R = circumradius; matches surfaceCheck per-triangle quality within 6e-8 relative on the R3 fuselage

Q_MIN.rationale: excludes slivers; every baseline union (R3 1.6e-12, R5-C 9.7e-13) and every R3 component (8e-4 to 1.6e-6) is below it, so R6 must be better than all of them

Q_P1_MIN.rationale: ~aspect 150 for a right triangle; allows LE-clustered anisotropy but not sliver populations (R5-C median is 0.081)

ANGLE_MIN_DEG.rationale: R3 components p1 0.56-1.98 deg; a floor of 1 deg removes needle triangles

ANGLE_P5_MIN_DEG.rationale: keeps the bulk of the surface well shaped

ASPECT_MAX.rationale: longest edge / shortest altitude; forces LE chordwise spacing to be coupled to spanwise spacing

GRADE_AREA_MAX.rationale: R3 components 16-81, R5-C 2.9e5; adjacent area ratio cap

KINK_MAX.rationale: mean turning at station lines / mean turning elsewhere along the same longitudinal or spanwise grid lines; R5-A fuselage 2.6, wing 64

self_intersection: 0 from all three checkers (m3 locator, PyMeshLab via r6_selfint subprocess, surfaceCheck v1912). Unchanged from contract 02.

not_adopted.Q_MEDIAN_MIN_0.4: suggested by the checks worker; not adopted because a median target is not tied to an aerodynamic or meshing failure mode and would push the wing toward isotropic triangles without benefit for snappyHexMesh projection. Recorded here before generation.

known_risk: surfaceCheck reports 255 self-intersection records on the R3 fuselage alone while the locator reports 0 and PyMeshLab flags 6 faces at different places; the trigger is not understood. If R6 fuselage shows surfaceCheck records while the other checkers show 0, M3 still FAILS; the next step is a synthetic calibration study of surfaceCheck, not a gate change.
